events.title: TinSpring Soccer Demo 1.0 — Finer control, smoother play
events.summary: October 23, 2026 The TinSpring Soccer Demo 1.0 update is here! This update improves the controls, match flow and menus: • Finer goalkeeper movement: tap for small adjustments, hold to build speed, or hold Shift for precise control. • Correct half-length settings: one minute now means one full minute in each half. • Clearer quick-match options: continue your current match, start a new one or return. • An easier-to-find language selector and improved text-size, contrast and reduced-motion settings

events.title: TinSpring Soccer – Demo Update 2 – October 4, 2026
events.summary: October 4, 2026The second TinSpring Soccer demo update brings smoother play, more natural shadows and a more polished presentation.What’s improvedSmoother matches, especially at 4K We’ve optimized rendering for better performance, while keeping the rich tabletop detail and visual effects.More natural shadows The figures now cast clearer, full-body shadows with softly blended edges, replacing the overly faint, blurred look at the highest graphics settings.A refreshed logo and loading screen Riche

events.title: TinSpring Soccer Demo — Update Highlights
events.summary: TinSpring Soccer Demo — September 30, 2026 — Update Highlights - Optimized for higher frame rates and lower hardware demands while preserving visual quality.- Smoother ball rolling, fast shots and rebounds.- Polished menus, panels, logo and loading screens, with clearer navigation.- More natural finger controls with improved artwork and corrected orientation when the board turns.- Green checkmarks clearly identify the pitches and balls available in the demo.- New FPS options: 30, 60, 70, 120, 14
